fact: On 13 May 2019 the Communauté Urbaine de Douala issued a tender for building numbering plates and a georeferenced database of plates in the Douala 4 commune, as part of its addressing project.
title: Avis d'appel d'offres national ouvert n°014/AONO/CUD/CIPM/2019 du 13/05/2019 relatif au projet d'adressage
